affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 685 recorded at Army entry on March 16, 1943; no employer, workplace, exact trade, or start date is named

claims.claim_text: The private identifier printed for John L. Boyd resolves to a differently named person in the official Army merged file; the conflict is retained and neither identity is promoted.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Identifier resolves to a different name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The visually checked index identifier produced one official Army record, but its name does not match John L. Boyd.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting. An identifier alone cannot override a wholly different name when the official file itself warns of duplicate and corrupted values.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record cannot be assigned to the indexed person, so its chronology and occupation are withheld.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier and unrelated Army-record name remain private.

claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry to March 16, 1943; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS assignment date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains masked publicly. The Army record documents private-at-entry grade without implying the later OSS role.

claims.claim_text: The official Army entry record places Stanley E. Boyd in the broad civilian group for semiskilled welders and flame cutters.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Code 685 was recorded at Army entry on March 16, 1943 and maps to semiskilled welders and flame cutters.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed exact private-identifier and name match.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry; not a named employer and not proven to be the immediate predecessor to OSS.
claims.match_notes: No employer, workplace, exact trade, location, duties beyond the broad code, or Army-to-OSS sequence is inferred.
